prompt: SCENE 1889 - BULGARIA, BELOGRADCHIK ROCKS SAFE OVERLOOK. Create one original photorealistic cinematic vertical 9:16 sci-fi travel-editorial still. The cast is exactly four distinct fictional adult women, every one exactly age 21 and female-only: blonde Radiance, dark-haired Ellie, Black Alia, and brunette AI ECE. No other people. The three attached reference images, uploaded in authoritative order as scenes 938, 936, and 937, are identity-only anchors for this recurring fictional quartet; preserve their canonical faces and role mapping while creating a wholly new pose, wardrobe, setting, and composition. Public-safe adult presentation only. Use bold distinct high-fashion party and runway couture with satin, lace-over-opaque, lacquered latex-look, metallic, and structured materials; every short silhouette must be secure, fully opaque, lined, and clearly divided where two-piece styling is used. Use abstract Bulgarian rose-petal curves, woven rhombus geometry, copper-gold filigree, Black Sea wave lines, and Rhodope ridge facets with no literal flag, official emblem, text, or copied ceremonial clothing. Place the quartet centered on a broad, dry, level, fully fenced secular viewing deck, well back from the continuous guardrail, while immense red sandstone towers, forest valleys, layered blue distance, and open sky dominate the composition; show no fortress or structure resembling one. No religion, sacred sites, monuments, government, politics, uniforms, weapons, tactical props, animals, bystanders, signs, vehicles, letters, logos, watermarks, nudity, explicit sexuality, minors, or real-person identity. Freeze a safe wind-steadying beat: ECE protects Radiance with one firm hand at Radiance's upper arm; Ellie gives their closeness a clearly playful jealous hand-on-hip pose and lifted chin; Alia reassures Ellie with one brief consensual cheek peck, cheek contact only and never mouth-to-mouth; Radiance reaches across so all four finish in a warm reconciled hand-linked inward diamond. Radiance wears sapphire-gold metallic mini-dress couture; Ellie rose-black lined lacquered skort couture; Alia ivory-copper lace-over-opaque mini-dress with rhombus panels; ECE emerald-silver structured two-piece with a clearly divided mini-skirt and ridge-facet shoulders. Give each woman distinct secure runway footwear. Suggest a slow stabilized aerial pullback centered over the safe deck, never over an edge. CAMERA ROLL 83/100 - EXTREME WIDE. Show all four complete full bodies at no more than 15 percent of total frame height. The quartet must be tiny but readable, with at least 80 percent of the frame devoted to the sandstone towers, forest valleys, layered distance, and sky. Keep the guardrail visibly continuous. The protective steadying, playful jealousy, cheek-only peck, and four-way reconciliation must remain legible without enlarging the women. No leaning, climbing, running, jumping, spinning, stumbles, falls, props, or unsafe motion.
